name: brand-guidelines
title: Brand Guidelines
description: A complete editorial identity film: a geometric brand mark, a terracotta, graphite, stone and paper palette, a type specimen that types and deletes itself through eight styles, a layered collage of drawn object plates, and three flipping tiles that become the closing wordmark. Silent: sound is added by the host. The object photos are drawn with SVG by default; pass image paths to use real photographs.
useWhen: You want to introduce a brand system through its mark, colors, typography, and photography.
You need a complete 17.9-second identity film with editable content and a layered object collage.
avoidWhen: You need a multi-feature software demo rather than an identity film: use launch-anything.
You only need a short typed title with an exit: use typed-split-wipe.
author: Remocn
